svg.title: Toolkit, client
svg.desc: Isometric keyboard where each tool is a keycap carrying its logo. The keys strike one after another and flash their brand colour, packets run along the floor grid, and tools in production project a turning hologram of their logo. A name panel sits beside it. languages: typescript, javascript, python, go, rust; frontend: react, next.js, vue, tailwind, three.js. In production now: typescript, react.
